limits: Displayed browser traces omit the automatic reply immediately after UI charity confirmation; paired comparison transcripts include their full exchanges.
Browser interactions used the built app during Preview build; hosted page, examples, health and absence of production account route were then checked via Vercel.
Only synthetic records and mock accounts; typed input, no live regulator, voice transcription, emails, subscriptions or payments.
First six-pair comparison precedes final shorter high-reasoning prompt; it is not a paired cost/quality benchmark for that revision.
recommendation: Refine; do not adopt. Lower initial sampled cost and simpler orchestration, but no demonstrated consistent naturalness improvement. Final Frogs answer still closes with a generic acknowledgement.
